## HueMux v0.0.5-alpha.7 — Icons that actually refresh

> **Alpha.** Asset-only follow-up to v0.0.5-alpha.6. No multiplexer behavior
> changed.

The three-input mark was already in alpha.6's header, SVG sources, and
adaptive Android vector. Two surfaces still looked old because of caching and
missing raster fallbacks.

### Browser tab

The pages now request `/favicon.svg?v=0.0.5-alpha.7`, so a browser cannot keep
serving the previous cached mark. A multi-resolution `favicon.ico` is also
shipped as an alternate icon for browsers that ignore SVG favicons.

### Android launcher

The adaptive vector was already correct, but the APK had no density-specific
bitmaps. `mipmap-mdpi` through `mipmap-xxxhdpi` now contain the new mark, which
covers launchers and stores that do not use the adaptive resource. Install the
alpha.7 APK; if the launcher still shows the old icon, clear its cache or
reinstall, because Android caches launcher icons per package.

### Generator

`scripts/gen-icon.py` now emits `web/favicon.ico` and the Android mipmap PNGs
in addition to the SVG and adaptive-vector outputs. ImageMagick is optional:
the vector pipeline still runs without it.

### Verification

The icon generator ran clean and produced a valid three-resolution ICO and all
five Android density bitmaps. No Go code or mux primitives changed, so the
alpha.6 behavior and limits are unchanged.
